id: validation-Deployment Synchronization with Instance-Invariant Storage Code-case-4

pointer.content:
Test Case 4: Storage Commits Present in Repository

Input: Check git repository for storage implementation commits

Expected Output:
{
  "allCommitsPresent": true,
  "commits": ["ef0d29c", "d414213", "e6a096b"]
}

Validation Logic:
- For each commit (ef0d29c, d414213, e6a096b):
  - Run: git log --oneline --all | grep <commit>
  - Check exit code (0 = found)
- Verify all 3 commits are present

Commit Details:
- ef0d29c: Backend API endpoints (POST/GET /v2/activities/storage)
- d414213: CLI MCP tools (metabob_activity_save/load)
- e6a096b: OpenCode enforcement (Activity.save/load backend sync)

Pass Criteria:
- All 3 storage commits present in repository
- Confirms code implementation is complete
